title: SpaceX TeraFab
summary: SpaceX TeraFab Type: entity Tags: #semiconductor #fab #spacex #tesla #intel #xAI ## Overview TeraFab is a planned semiconductor fabrication plant jointly developed by Tesla, SpaceX, xAI, and Intel. Announced by Elon Musk on March 21, 2025. ## Key Facts - Investment: $55 billion initial, up to $119 billion total - Location: Grimes County, Texas (near College Station) - Tax Abatement: 35-year, 100% property tax exemption approved June 2026 - SpaceX pays $10M upfront + $20M/year to county - Despite resident backlash and threatened legal action - Purpose: Supply AI/semiconductor chips for SpaceX, xAI, and Tesla - Intel Partnership: Intel joined as partner for manufacturing expertise ## Timeline - 2025-03-21: Announced by Elon Musk - 2026-05-07: Property tax abatement agreement sought - 2026-06-03: Grimes County approved tax incentives (Reuters) - 2026-06-04: FT confirmed property tax exemption won ## Supply Chain Impact - Vertical integration play for AI compute hardware - Reduces dependence on TSMC/Samsung for custom AI chips - Signals major capex shift from cloud providers to in-house semiconductor manufacturing - Property tax abatement model may attract other chip projects to Texas ## Sources - FT: SpaceX wins tax exemption for $55bn AI chip plant - Reuters: SpaceX wins Texas tax breaks for chip project - Tom's Hardware: $55B TeraFab semiconductor factory - Wikipedia: Terafab ## Related - [[spacex]] - [[tesla]] - [[intel]] - [[semiconductor-fabrication]] - [[ai-infrastructure]]
